title: Global Discounts
description: Makes villager curing apply to all players, not just the player who cured the villager
body: Annoyed that villager curing only affects the player who cured the villager? Well this mod aims to fix that issue. This makes it so all players can gain the cured villager discounts! If you are playing on older versions, there are plenty of other mods that do the exact same thing. I recomend checking them out!
